page.layout: One column of running text, with marginal notes in the left margin. Page number and running head at the top. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: sententiam depravet Bellarminus, ostendit Pontificios argui a Luthero, Melanchthone, Magdeburgensibus, Calvino, & quodam de Calvini schola, tanquam divino cultu prosequantur Virginem Mariam, defunctas creaturas, ossa, vestes, calceos, statuas, simulacra, & hæc, inquit, impostura, mendacia, impudentissima sunt. Impudentissima? Qui hoc probat? Aculeatis punctis[?] percontationum, quibus asseverat, neminem Papistarum unquam uni vero Deo, vel imagines, vel reliquias, vel Sanctos, aut Martyres, aut Apostolos, aut Angelos, aut ipsam denique cœli Reginam, Deisque matrem Mariam ullo modo æquasse: neminem in ipsorum Ecclesia sacrificium, quod uni debetur Deo, vel Sanctis, vel reliquiis, vel imaginibus obtulisse: quin etiam se aperte distinguere (per latriam scilicet, ac dulia) inter eum honorem, qui soli Deo debetur, & eum cultum ac venerationem, quæ Dei amicis aliisque sacris rebus, propter ipsum Deum, pie religioseque tribuitur. Vetus est verbum Sapientis, & in spiri-tuali, nō carnali modo, scortatione verù:Prov.3o.2o. {a}Mulier scortans comedit; deinde abstergit os suum; tum di-cit, non sum operata iniquitatem. Verum Romana Ecclesia tales maculas suarum scortationum tam multis locis asperfit, & quod vix fecerunt{b} adulterae Romanae temporibus impurissimis, in conspectum affert tam recentes notas turpitudinis suae: ut quantumvis verbo neget se scortatam, evidentia tamen rei teneatur; eodem plane modo quo Iudaeorum synagoga, de qua Ieremias, {c}O qua corrigia notat vias suas. Na, ut Bellarmini percotationib[?] percotationes similes opponam, sed veraciores, nonne cereas pupas, quas agnos Dei vocant, {d}Deo, cuius sanguinis fumus redeti, aliquo modo æquat quado de ea-Sueton.in Auguft. cap 69.in Calig. cap.36.Iuven. sat.11.Ierem.2.23.Act.20.28.

page.notes: Page number "62" read from a worn mark at the top left. The running head's final letter is uncertain. The text ends with the hyphenated word "ea-", which continues as "rum" in the catchword. The marginal note "Prov.3o.2o." and the note "Sueton." line are hard to read at this scan resolution and are copied as best seen. Marks [?] on "punctis" and "percotationib" are doubtful. The superscript "a" after "Pontificios" was not clearly separable from the ligature there and was not marked. The note "fat.11" is read as "sat.11" and is uncertain. The paragraph break before "tribuitur" is not visible in the scan, so the passage is treated as one paragraph.
